video_title: 👀🏀 Pau Gasol habla del FUTURO del Barça y la NBA Europa

quotes.speaker: Pau Gasol
quotes.summary_phrase: Pau Gasol on the potential for an EuroLeague and NBA Europe agreement
quotes.excerpt: The model has to evolve, has to improve, has to be a model sustainable with margin of growth.
quotes.quote: The model has to evolve, has to improve, has to be a model sustainable with margin of growth, better managed, to give it a value and a quality that is necessary for its continuity. It could have it, but in a way that makes much more sense for everyone. As Jayson Tatum said, the deputy commissioner of the NBA, this was going to move forward with cohesion or without cohesion. We all want the best for basketball, and we have to keep in mind what is best for the sport.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: El model ha d'evolucionar, ha de millorar, ha de ser un model sostenible amb marge de creixement, millor gestionat, per donar-li també un valor i una qualitat que és necessària de cara a la seva continuïtat. La podria tenir, però d'una forma que tingui molt més sentit per a tots. Com va dir Jayson Tatum, el deputy commissioner de la NBA, que això anava a tirar endavant amb cohesió o sense cohesió. Tots volem el millor, i hem de tenir en ment i present què és el millor per al bàsquet.

quotes.speaker: Pau Gasol
quotes.summary_phrase: Pau Gasol on Barcelona's interest in the NBA Europe project
quotes.excerpt: Barcelona is open to the possibility of NBA Europe. Barcelona wants to be in the best European league.
quotes.quote: Barcelona is open to the possibility of NBA Europe. Barcelona has clear that it wants to be in the best European league, but at the same time, it has to understand better the model, the project, the conditions, and see that certain things are happening. The presidential elections have prioritized other things, but we had to have clarity that we have it now, and starting July 1, Joan will resume official control of the club. I am very close to the club to be able to manage what would be valuing the entry into the project.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: El Barça està obert a la possibilitat de la NBA Europa. El Barça té clar que vol estar a la millor lliga europea, però a la vegada, té també que entendre millor el model, el projecte, les condicions, i anar veient que certes coses van succeint. Les eleccions presidencials han posat potser han prioritzat altres coses, teníem que tenir claredat que la tenim ja, i a partir de l'1 de juliol el Joan reprendrà el control oficialment del club, i també estic molt proper al club per poder també gestionar el que seria valorar l'entrada en el projecte.
